evidence.reason: The finding alleges the `except Refused` handler writes only to stderr and no JSON artifact to stdout. At the pinned tip that handler (lines 1487-1491) now emits `_error_artifact("refused", args.operation, str(exc), 2)` as JSON on stdout before narrating to stderr and returning 2. History commit 4a4f7003f90e52154d8b0aa60812ff7375b50440 ("fix(review): emit a refusal artifact and keep pre-helper failures on exit 2") is the fix; the adjacent pre-helper ValueError/OSError path (1492-1501) was also converted to the same artifact. The proposed defect no longer exists at the tip.
